desc:
Welcome to Spot and Mark 🔍

👉 You or your opponent picks a object! 
❌ While one finds the object, the other marks their page with X's
🔄 Switch turns once the object has been found!
👑 Fill up your page before your Opponent to WIN!

Be quick in finding the object as well as marking the page!!

NEW UPDATE: Added some polish and bug fixes!

✨Like and favorite the game to show support!
